```{r}
####Read in Data
#LongGF
my_files <- list.files(path = "/home/ryleyd/LongReadFusionCallerBenchmark", pattern = "LongGF", full.names=TRUE)
all_tsv <-lapply(my_files, read.table)
names <- gsub(".tsv","", list.files(path = "/home/ryleyd/LongReadFusionCallerBenchmark", pattern = "LongGF",full.names = FALSE),fixed = TRUE)
for(i in names){
  assign(i, read.table(paste0("/home/ryleyd/LongReadFusionCallerBenchmark/", i, ".tsv")))
}

LongGF_Sim <- rbind(LongGF_Negative_Control, LongGF_Spiked)%>%
      mutate(Source = basename(V1)) %>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", Source), "positive", "negative"))
ogLongGF <- rbind(LongGF_Negative_Control, LongGF_Spiked)%>%
      mutate(Source = basename(V1)) %>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", Source), "positive", "negative"))
#Genion
myfiles<- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Simulated_Reads_June_2024", pattern = "*_genion\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
Genion_Sim<- do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  if (file.info(filename)$size > 0) {
    read.table(filename) %>%
      mutate(Source = basename(filename)) %>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", Source), "positive", "negative"))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))

#FusionSeeker
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Simulated_Reads_June_2024", pattern = "confident_genefusion.txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
FusionSeeker_Sim <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(dirname(filename)))%>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", Source), "positive", "negative"))
}))
ogFusionSeeker <- do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(dirname(filename)))%>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", Source), "positive", "negative"))
}))

    mutate(Source = basename(dirname(filename))) %>% mutate(control = ifelse(grepl("Spiked", sample), "positive", "negative"))
}))
ogJAFFAL <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE, sep = ",") %>%

}))
```

```{r}
#ensembl <- useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = 109)

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", host = "https://jul2023.archive.ensembl.org")
LongGF_Sim <- LongGF_Sim %>% separate(V2, into = c("Gene1", "Gene2"), sep = ":", remove = FALSE) #V2 = fusion gene name :
Gene1_Name<-getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "external_gene_name",
                             values = unique(LongGF_Sim$Gene1),
                             mart = ensembl) 
Gene2_Name<-getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "external_gene_name",
                             values = unique(LongGF_Sim$Gene2),
                             mart = ensembl)
LongGF_Sim <- left_join(LongGF_Sim, Gene1_Name, by= c('Gene1'='external_gene_name')) %>% left_join(Gene2_Name, by= c('Gene2'='external_gene_name')) %>% unique() %>%
          mutate(ensembl_gene1 = ifelse(is.na(ensembl_gene_id.x) |nchar(ensembl_gene_id.x) == 0, Gene1, ensembl_gene_id.x), ensembl_gene2 = ifelse(is.na(ensembl_gene_id.y) |nchar(ensembl_gene_id.y) == 0, Gene2, ensembl_gene_id.y)) %>% unite("fusion.gene.id", c(ensembl_gene1, ensembl_gene2), sep=":", remove= FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Annotate as known or false positive
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", host = "https://jul2023.archive.ensembl.org")
#ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", host = "https://feb2023.archive.ensembl.org")
#ensembl <- useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = 109)
Gene1_Name<-getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_gene_id_version"),
                             filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                             values = unique(Simulated_Fusion_Info$geneName),
                             mart = ensembl) 

Simulated_Fusion_Info_2 <- (left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info[1:(ncol(Simulated_Fusion_Info)-2)], Gene1_Name, by = c("V1"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
                              left_join(Gene1_Name, by = c("V2"="ensembl_gene_id"))%>% left_join(Gene1_Name, by = c("V3"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
                              mutate(ensembl_gene.x = ifelse(is.na(external_gene_name.x) |nchar(external_gene_name.x) == 0, V1, external_gene_name.x), 
                                     ensembl_gene.y = ifelse(is.na(external_gene_name.y) |nchar(external_gene_name.y) == 0, V2, external_gene_name.y), 
                                     ensembl_gene = ifelse(is.na(external_gene_name) |nchar(external_gene_name) == 0, V3, external_gene_name)) %>% 
                              unite('fusion.gene.name', c("ensembl_gene.x","ensembl_gene.y", "ensembl_gene"), sep = ":", na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
                              unite('fusion.gene.id_version', c("ensembl_gene_id_version.x","ensembl_gene_id_version.y", "ensembl_gene_id_version"), sep = ":", na.rm = TRUE) %>%
                              unite('fusion.gene.id', c("V1","V2", "V3"), sep = ":", na.rm = TRUE, remove = FALSE)) %>% 
                              unite('raw.fusion.gene.name', c("external_gene_name.x","external_gene_name.y", "external_gene_name"), sep = ":", na.rm = TRUE) 

Annot_JAFFAL_Sim <- JAFFAL_Sim[c(1:22,27:29)] %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = c('fusion.gene.id', 'fusion.genes'='fusion.gene.name')) 
Annot_JAFFAL_Sim <- JAFFAL_Sim %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = c('fusion.gene.id', 'fusion.genes'='fusion.gene.name')) %>%
  filter(# Existing conditions with corrected mapply usage
    (is.na(chromosome_name.x) | 
     chromosome_name.x == gsub("chr", "", chrom1) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl(paste0("chr", x), y), chromosome_name.x, chrom1) |
     (chromosome_name.x == "X" & chrom1 == "chrY") |
     (chromosome_name.x == "Y" & chrom1 == "chrX")) &
    
    (is.na(chromosome_name.y) | 
     chromosome_name.y == gsub("chr", "", chrom2) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl(paste0("chr", x), y), chromosome_name.y, chrom2) |
     (chromosome_name.y == "X" & chrom2 == "chrY") |
     (chromosome_name.y == "Y" & chrom2 == "chrX")) )

library(stringr)

# Check if ensembl_gene1 and ensembl_gene2 are contained in fusion.gene.id
Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$fusionType <- mapply(function(g1, g2, current_type, chr1, chr2) {
   # Check if the current fusionType is empty
  if (current_type == "" || is.na(current_type)) {
    if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g2)))) {
      return("truncated_tri_fusion")
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
       matching_row <- subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")[which(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))]
      return(paste("reverse_order:", matching_row[1])) 
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
      return("reverse_order:truncated_tri_fusion") 
    } else if ((grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE))){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial_genomic") 
    }else if (grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial") 
    }else {
      return("false_fusion")
    }
  }
  return(current_type)
}, Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$ensembl_gene1, Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$ensembl_gene2, Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$fusionType, Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$chrom1, Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$chrom2)

Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim <- JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim[c(1:10,17:20)] %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = c('fusion.gene.id', 'Fusion'='fusion.gene.name'))
Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$fusionType <- mapply(function(g1, g2, g3, current_type) {
   if (current_type == "" || is.na(current_type)) {
        
     #check if reverse order tri-fusion
        if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g3, ":", g2, ":", g1)))) {
            return("reverse_order:tri_fusion")}
     
     #check if its a butchered tri-fusion
        if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g3, ":", g1, ":", g2)) |
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g3, ":", g1))| 
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g3, ":", g2))| 
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1, ":", g3)))) {
            return("wrong_order:tri_fusion")
          }else {
          return("false_fusion")
        }
   }
  return(current_type)}, Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$Gene1, Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$Gene2, Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$Gene3, Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$fusionType)


Annot_LongGF_Sim <- LongGF_Sim %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = c('fusion.gene.id', 'V2'='fusion.gene.name')) %>%
  filter(
    # Filter for chromosome_name.x and V4 conditions
    (mapply(function(x, y) grepl(paste0("chr", x), y), chromosome_name.x, V4) | 
     is.na(chromosome_name.x) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) !grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y|MT):", x) && grepl("PATCH|HSCHR", y), V4, chromosome_name.x) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrX", x) && grepl("X", y), V4, chromosome_name.x) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrY", x) && grepl("Y", y), V4, chromosome_name.x)|
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrM", x) && grepl("MT", y), V4, chromosome_name.x)) &
    
    # Filter for chromosome_name.y and V5 conditions
    (mapply(function(x, y) grepl(paste0("chr", x), y), chromosome_name.y, V5) | 
     is.na(chromosome_name.y) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) !grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y|MT):", x) && grepl("PATCH|HSCHR", y), V5, chromosome_name.y) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrX", x) && grepl("X", y), V5, chromosome_name.y) | 
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrY", x) && grepl("Y", y), V5, chromosome_name.y)|
     mapply(function(x, y) grepl("chrM", x) && grepl("MT", y), V5, chromosome_name.y))
  )
Annot_LongGF_Sim$fusionType <- mapply(function(g1, g2, current_type, chr1, chr2) {
   # Check if the current fusionType is empty
  if (current_type == "" || is.na(current_type)) {
    if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g2)))) {
      return("truncated_tri_fusion")
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
      return("reverse_order:truncated_tri_fusion") 
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
       matching_row <- subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusionType[which(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))]
      return(paste("reverse_order:", matching_row[1])) 
    } else if ((grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE))){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial_genomic") 
    }else if (grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial") 
    }else {
      return("false_fusion")
    }
  }
  return(current_type)
}, Annot_LongGF_Sim$ensembl_gene_id.x, Annot_LongGF_Sim$ensembl_gene_id.y, Annot_LongGF_Sim$fusionType, Annot_LongGF_Sim$V4, Annot_LongGF_Sim$V5)


Annot_Genion_Sim <- Genion_Sim %>% separate(V1, into = c("V1.1", "V1.2", "V1.3"), "::", remove=FALSE) %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1", "V2.2", "V2.3"), "::", remove=FALSE) %>% separate(V8, into = c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3"), ";", remove=FALSE)
Annot_Genion_Sim[c("V1", "V2")] <- lapply(Genion_Sim[c("V1", "V2")], function(x) gsub("::", ":", x))
Annot_Genion_Sim <- Annot_Genion_Sim %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = c('V1'='fusion.gene.id', 'V2'='fusion.gene.name')) 
Annot_Genion_Sim$fusionType <- mapply(function(g1, g2, g3, current_type, chr1, chr2, chr3) {
  # Check if the current fusionType is empty
  if (current_type == "" || is.na(current_type)) {
    
        #check if this is two part or tri part fusion
        if(g3 == ""|| is.na(g3)){
          
           #check if part of tri fusion
            if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g2)) |
                    str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g3)))) {
              return("truncated_tri_fusion")} 
            else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
              return("reverse_order:truncated_tri_fusion")} 
          
          #check for reverse order two part genes
            else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
              matching_row <- subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusionType[which(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))]
              return(paste("reverse_order:", matching_row[1]))}
        }
      
      #check if this fusion contains mitochondrial genes 
        if ((grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & (!grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE) | !grepl("chrM:", chr3, ignore.case = TRUE))) |
                 (grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE) & (!grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE)| !grepl("chrM:", chr3, ignore.case = TRUE)))|
                 (grepl("chrM:", chr3, ignore.case = TRUE) & (!grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE)| !grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)))){
          return("false_fusion:mitochondrial_genomic")} 
      
        else if (grepl("chrM:", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", chr3, ignore.case = TRUE)){
          return("false_fusion:mitochondrial")}
    
        #check if its a butchered tri-fusion
        if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g3, ":", g1, ":", g2)) |
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g3, ":", g1))| 
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g3, ":", g2))| 
                str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1, ":", g3)))) {
            return("wrong_order:tri_fusion")}
    
        #check if reverse order tri-fusion
        if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g3, ":", g2, ":", g1)))) {
            return("reverse_order:tri_fusion")}
    
    #if blank and none of the above, its just a false fusion
      else {
          return("false_fusion")}
    
    }
  #if it's not blank, its already been labelled
  else {return(current_type)}
  }, Annot_Genion_Sim$V1.1, Annot_Genion_Sim$V1.2,  Annot_Genion_Sim$V1.3, Annot_Genion_Sim$fusionType, Annot_Genion_Sim$chr1, Annot_Genion_Sim$chr2 , Annot_Genion_Sim$chr3)
      

Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim <- unite(FusionSeeker_Sim, "fusion.gene.id", c(ensembl_gene_id.x, ensembl_gene_id.y), sep=":", remove= FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>% left_join(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, by = 'fusion.gene.id') 

Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$fusionType <- mapply(function(g1, g2, current_type, chr1, chr2) {
   # Check if the current fusionType is empty
  if (current_type == "" || is.na(current_type)) {
    if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g1, ":", g2)))) {
      return("truncated_tri_fusion")
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType == "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
      return("reverse_order:truncated_tri_fusion") 
    } else if (any(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))){
       matching_row <- subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusionType[which(str_detect(subset(Simulated_Fusion_Info_2, fusionType != "tri_fusion")$fusion.gene.id, paste0(g2, ":", g1)))]
      return(paste("reverse_order:", matching_row[1])) 
    } else if ((grepl("chrM", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE))){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial_genomic") 
    }else if (grepl("chrM", chr1, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM", chr2, ignore.case = TRUE)){
      return("false_fusion:mitochondrial") 
    }else {
      return("false_fusion")
    }
  }
  return(current_type)
}, Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$ensembl_gene_id.x, Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$ensembl_gene_id.y, Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$fusionType, Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$Chrom1, Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$Chrom2)
```

```{r}
Annot_LongGF_Sim$Algorithm <- "LongGF"
Annot_JAFFAL_Sim$Algorithm <- "JAFFAL"
Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim$Algorithm <- "JAFFAL"
Annot_Genion_Sim$Algorithm <- "Genion"
Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim$Algorithm <- "FusionSeeker"

Annot_LongGF_Sim[c(2,5,9, 14, 30,34, 35)]
Annot_JAFFAL_Sim[c(2, 13, 22, 27, 43, 47, 48)]
Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim[c(1, 5, 10, 11, 28, 32, 33)]
Annot_Genion_Sim[c(1, 5, 11, 19, 33, 37, 38)]
Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim[c(4,11, 14, 19,35,40, 41)]

dLGF<- Annot_LongGF_Sim[c(2,5,9, 14, 30,34, 35)] %>%
  rename(read_supp = V3.x,
         fusion.genes = V2)
dJF <- Annot_JAFFAL_Sim[c(2, 13, 22, 27, 43, 47, 48)] %>%
  rename(read_supp = spanning.reads)
dJF3 <- Annot_JAFFAL_3Gene_Sim[c(1, 5, 10, 11, 28, 32, 33)]%>%
  rename(read_supp = Reads,
         fusion.genes = Fusion)
dGen <- Annot_Genion_Sim[c(1, 5, 11, 19, 33, 37, 38)]%>%
  rename(read_supp = V5,
         fusion.genes = V2,
         fusion.gene.id = V1)
dFS <- Annot_FusionSeeker_Sim[c(4,11, 14, 19,35,40, 41)]%>%
  rename(read_supp = NumSupp,
         fusion.genes = fusion.gene)
combined_data <- rbind(dLGF, dJF, dJF3, dGen, dFS)
combined_data$read_supp <- as.numeric(combined_data$read_supp)

library(ggplot2)
False_total <- ggplot(filter(combined_data, control == "negative", 
         read_supp > 2), aes(x = fusionType, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Algorithm) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "False calls in the Negative Control, minimum read support of 2", x = "Fusion Type", y = "Count")+
  scale_y_log10()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("False_total_in_Neg_Cont.png", plot = False_total, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600) 

# Summarize the data
summary_df <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(fusionType, read_supp, control, Algorithm) %>%   # Group by fusionType and read_supp
  summarise(
    count = n()                        # Count the number of occurrences
  ) %>%
  ungroup()                             # Remove grouping to avoid issues with further operations

# View the summarized data
summary_df$read_supp <- as.numeric(summary_df$read_supp)

ggplot(filter(summary_df, control == 'negative'), aes(x = read_supp, y = count, color = fusionType)) +
  geom_point() +  # Add jitter for visibility
  facet_wrap(~ Algorithm) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Count of Fusion Types by Read Support and Algorithm", 
       x = "Read Support", 
       y = "Count")+
  scale_y_log10()

ggplot(filter(summary_df, control == 'negative'), aes(x = count, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, adjust = 1.5) +  # Adjust bandwidth for smoothing if needed
  facet_wrap(~ Algorithm) +  # Facet by Algorithm
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of Fusion Types by Algorithm", 
       x = "Count", 
       y = "Density") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+  # Optional: Use a color palette for better visuals
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot(filter(summary_df, control == 'negative'), aes(x = read_supp, y = count, color = Algorithm, shape = fusionType)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + # Use geom_point for a scatter plot
  labs(title = "Counts by Read Support and Algorithm",
       x = "Read Support",
       y = "Count",
       color = "Algorithm") + # Modify color legend title
  theme_minimal() + # Use a minimal theme
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+ # Optional: Adjust color palette
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()

Read_Supp_Neg <- ggplot(filter(combined_data, control == 'negative', 
         read_supp > 2), aes(x = Algorithm, y = read_supp)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Algorithm)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Read Support for False Fusions",
       x = "Fusion Type",
       y = "Read Support") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ fusionType) +  # Create a separate plot for each Algorithm
  scale_y_log10()+  # Optional: Use log scale if appropriate
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("Read_supp_False_in_Neg_Cont.png", plot = Read_Supp_Neg, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
